tests.name: zoomPlugin has the real, expected shape — id and every real lifecycle hook
zoomPlugin start attaches the full programmatic API onto the live chart instance
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() zooms in the enabled directions, changing scale.options.min/max, and calls chart.update
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() zooming out (amount < 1) widens the range
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() does not zoom a direction whose scale axis is disabled by mode
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() applies overScaleMode, exercising getEnabledScalesByPoint's own real branch for it
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() zooms only the scale directly under the focal point when scaleMode enables its own axis there
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() zooms a y-axis scale directly via the programmatic API (not just through a drag)
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() resolves mode as a function of the chart, not just a string literal
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() treats an unrecognized mode value as disabling every direction (the final false fallback)
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() zooms no scale at all when the focal point falls outside every scale's own bounds
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() treats an undefined zoom.mode as enabling every direction (directionEnabled's own default branch)
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() resolves mode as a function for directionsEnabled (plural) too, not just directionEnabled (singular)
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() falls back to zooming every scale when zoom is called with no zoom config at all (getEnabledScalesByPoint's own default)
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() zooms out, producing a zoom level below 1 (getZoomLevel's own min<1 branch, not just the max branch)
zoomPlugin programmatic zoom() reports isZoomedOrPanned true from a max-only change too, not just a min change
zoomPlugin programmatic zoomRect() zooms each enabled scale to the pixel range implied by the two given points
zoomPlugin programmatic zoomScale() sets a specific scale directly to the given min/max range
zoomPlugin programmatic resetZoom() restores each scale to its original min/max options, clearing any zoom applied since
zoomPlugin programmatic resetZoom() deletes min/max entirely when there were no original options set at all
zoomPlugin programmatic resetZoom() deletes min/max for a scale that appears only after storeOriginalScaleLimits already ran (no original entry exists yet)
zoomPlugin programmatic pan() shifts the scale range by the given delta, without changing its span, and calls chart.update
zoomPlugin programmatic pan() pans a y-axis scale too (not just the x-axis branch already covered above)
zoomPlugin programmatic pan() applies a real time.round offset when panning a scale configured with one
zoomPlugin programmatic pan() does not throw and treats the pan as a no-op range when getValueForPixel resolves to undefined (panNumericalScale's own NaN guard)
zoomPlugin programmatic pan() accepts a plain numeric delta for both axes at once (pan()'s own typeof delta === 'number' branch)
zoomPlugin programmatic pan() pans only the explicitly given scale when enabledScales is passed directly (pan()'s own explicit-scales branch)
zoomPlugin programmatic pan() accumulates a same-signed stored delta on top of a new one (panScale's own sign-matching accumulation branch)
zoomPlugin getZoomLevel / isZoomedOrPanned / isZoomingOrPanning reports zoom level 1 (no zoom) before any zoom, and something else after
zoomPlugin getZoomLevel / isZoomedOrPanned / isZoomingOrPanning reports isZoomedOrPanned false before any zoom, true after
zoomPlugin getZoomLevel / isZoomedOrPanned / isZoomingOrPanning reports isZoomingOrPanning false outside of an active drag
zoomPlugin getInitialScaleBounds / getZoomedScaleBounds reports the original bounds before zoom, and the updated bounds after
zoomPlugin category scale zoom/pan zooms a category scale using integer index stepping, not fractional values
zoomPlugin category scale zoom/pan extends the category range by one label when fully zoomed in and zooming out further
zoomPlugin category scale zoom/pan zooms a category scale out (integerChange's own negative branch, not just the positive one)
zoomPlugin category scale zoom/pan pans a y-axis category scale (scaleLength's own height branch, not just width)
zoomPlugin category scale zoom/pan pans a category scale whose range is exactly 1 (panCategoryScale's own range===1 branches)
zoomPlugin category scale zoom/pan pans a category scale forward (toward higher indices) using its own integer step logic
zoomPlugin category scale zoom/pan pans a category scale backward (toward lower indices) using its own integer step logic
zoomPlugin category scale zoom/pan pans a non-linear scale type (e.g. timeseries) using panNonLinearScale, not the plain default
zoomPlugin category scale zoom/pan accumulates an unapplied pan delta rather than losing it, for a delta too small to move the range at all
zoomPlugin category scale zoom/pan resets the accumulated pan delta to zero after a pan that genuinely changes the range, not just when a tiny pan snaps back
zoomPlugin logarithmic scale zoom zooms a logarithmic scale using log-space math, not linear math
zoomPlugin logarithmic scale zoom leaves a logarithmic scale unchanged when the zoom center resolves to an undefined value
zoomPlugin limits enforcement never zooms a scale past its own configured min/max limit
zoomPlugin limits enforcement resolves a configured limit keyed by axis, not just by scale id (getScaleLimits' own fallback)
zoomPlugin limits enforcement resolves "original" back to the scale's own real value even when no explicit options.min/max was ever set (getLimit's own scale fallback)
zoomPlugin limits enforcement rejects a pan whose resulting range would violate a configured limit before ever computing a new range (updateRange's own early pan-limit check)
zoomPlugin limits enforcement rejects zooming in further once already at the configured minRange (updateRange's own minRange-reached check)
zoomPlugin limits enforcement resolves a limit of "original" back to the scale's own pre-zoom option value
zoomPlugin limits enforcement clamps at the upper limit specifically (fixRange's own max > maxLimit branch, not just min < minLimit)
zoomPlugin wheel-zoom interaction zooms in on a real wheel event when wheel.enabled is true
zoomPlugin wheel-zoom interaction zooms out on a positive deltaY wheel event (wheel's own deltaY>=0 branch, not just the negative one)
zoomPlugin wheel-zoom interaction wheel: a real, nonzero speed produces the exact hand-computed zoom percentage (kills a 1-speed → 1+speed mix-up)
zoomPlugin wheel-zoom interaction wheel: the focal point is computed from the real event target's own bounding rect, not the canvas's (kills clientX-rect.left → clientX+rect.left)
zoomPlugin wheel-zoom interaction wheel: the y-coordinate of the focal point uses the real target rect too, not just x (kills clientY-rect.top → clientY+rect.top)
zoomPlugin wheel-zoom interaction does not zoom when wheel.enabled is false (default)
zoomPlugin wheel-zoom interaction rejects the wheel zoom (and calls onZoomRejected) when a required wheel modifier key is not held
zoomPlugin wheel-zoom interaction calls onZoomStart, and aborts the zoom (calling onZoomRejected instead) when it returns false
zoomPlugin wheel-zoom interaction calls the debounced onZoomComplete callback after a real wheel zoom
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction zooms to the dragged rectangle on mousedown → mousemove → mouseup, past the configured threshold
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction zooms using only the y distance when mode is y-only (the distanceY branch, not just distanceX)
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction does not zoom when the drag distance stays under the configured threshold
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction cancels an in-progress drag when Escape is pressed
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction keyDown: does nothing when there is no drag in progress at all, even for a real Escape press (state.dragStart is falsy)
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction does not start a drag when mousedown targets the legend area
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction does not start a drag-to-zoom when a required drag modifier key is not held
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction rejects a drag-to-zoom start when the pan modifier key is held (pan takes priority over drag-zoom)
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction does not start a drag when a second mousedown targets the same document already being listened on
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction aborts a drag-to-zoom start when onZoomStart returns false (mouseDown's own zoomStart-rejected branch, not just wheel's)
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction drags along the x axis only, exercising mouseUp's own distanceY:0 branch (mode disables y)
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction applies drag-to-zoom with maintainAspectRatio, constraining the drag rectangle to the chart area's own aspect ratio
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction applies drag-to-zoom with maintainAspectRatio the other way (ratio < aspectRatio, adjusting height instead of width)
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction applyAspectRatio: a ratio one hair above aspectRatio still takes the width-adjustment branch (kills a > → >= boundary flip)
zoomPlugin drag-to-zoom-rectangle interaction applyAspectRatio: a ratio one hair below aspectRatio still takes the height-adjustment branch (kills a < → <= boundary flip)
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) ignores mouse-type pointer events entirely — mouse keeps using the separate mouse handlers
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) pointerDown: a mouse-type pointerdown never even reaches setPointerCapture (the real early-return happens before tracking anything at all)
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) pointerMove: a mouse-type pointermove never calls pan(), even for a pointerId a touch gesture already legitimately tracks
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) does not abort the gesture when setPointerCapture throws (a real, confirmed browser exception, not just a jsdom gap)
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) does not start a touch pan when the touch targets the legend area
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) pans a scale with a single touch, following frame-to-frame finger movement
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) pans a y-axis scale with a purely vertical touch drag (pointerMove's own dy!==0 branch, not just dx)
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) does not pan until movement crosses the configured pan.threshold
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) treats an omitted pan.threshold as zero (pointerMove's own threshold ?? 0 fallback)
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) calls onPanStart once threshold is crossed, and onPanRejected instead when it returns false
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) calls onPanComplete when the finger lifts after a real pan
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) does not call onPanComplete when the finger lifts before ever crossing the threshold
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) ignores a third simultaneous touch — only ever tracks the first two
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) starts a pinch-zoom gesture on a second touch when pinch.enabled, and zooms as the fingers move apart
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) does not start a pinch gesture when pinch is not enabled in config
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) aborts a pinch start when onZoomStart returns false
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) ends the pinch and calls onZoomComplete when a finger lifts back down to one pointer
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) ignores pointermove/pointerup for a pointerId that was never tracked
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) ignores a mouse-type pointerup too, not just pointerdown/pointermove (pointerUp's own mouse-exclusion check)
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) pointerDown: exactly two already-tracked pointers blocks a third from ever reaching setPointerCapture (the >= 2 boundary, not > 2)
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) pointerDown: omitting zoom.pinch entirely behaves identically to pinch.enabled:false (the real optional-chaining fallback, not a crash)
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) sets touch-action:none on the canvas while pan or pinch is enabled, and clears it when neither is
zoomPlugin touch pan + pinch-zoom (Pointer Events) clears touch-action and stops responding to pointer events after stop()
